intro.ko: 올리브 파카와 크림 스웨트셔츠 사이에 그레이 머플러를 자연스럽게 늘어뜨립니다. 브라운 코듀로이 팬츠와 어두운 부츠로 색의 온도를 이어가되 머플러 끝은 몸 가까이 정리하세요.
intro.en: A grey scarf hangs loosely between the olive parka and the cream sweatshirt. Brown corduroy and dark boots carry the warmth of the colours down, while the scarf ends stay close to the body.
intro.de: Zwischen olivgrünem Parka und cremefarbenem Sweatshirt hängt locker ein grauer Schal. Braune Cordhose und dunkle Boots tragen die Wärme der Farben nach unten, die Schalenden bleiben nah am Körper.

copy.pull: A HAND AT THE SCARF, A GLANCE BACK AT THE DOOR.

tip.en: Tuck damp scarf ends inside the parka so they don't grow heavy in the rain.
tip.de: Feuchte Schalenden in den Parka stecken, damit sie im Regen nicht schwer werden.
